# dokku_export (Data Source)

Reads the server, or the apps or resources it names, back as a docket recipe.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Export one app as a docket recipe.
data "dokku_export" "api" {
  apps   = ["api"]
  format = "yaml"
}

output "recipe" {
  value = data.dokku_export.api.recipe
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `apps` (List of String) Only export these apps. The global play is skipped. Conflicts with `resources`.
- `format` (String) The recipe format: `yaml` (the default), `json5` or `hcl`.
- `redact` (Boolean) Replace sensitive values with placeholders. Defaults to true. When false, sensitive values are lifted into `vars`.
- `resources` (List of String) Only export these resource addresses, such as `dokku_config[app=api]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The format of the export.
- `missing_apps` (List of String) Apps named in `apps` that do not exist.
- `missing_resources` (List of String) Addresses named in `resources` that matched nothing.
- `recipe` (String) The exported recipe.
- `vars` (Map of String, Sensitive) The values the recipe refers to as inputs, keyed by input name.
- `warnings` (List of String) Non-fatal problems the export ran into.
